adversarial_findings.title: kiosk.filters. trailing-dot key triggers if v-for iterates filter values
adversarial_findings.vector: if Vue component iterates kiosk.filters as 'for (key in $tm('kiosk.filters'))', the empty-key entry at line 1459 ('Tous') will be rendered with empty key name, producing label.Tous OR generating 'kiosk.filters.' fallback display
adversarial_findings.verified_in_code: grep $t(`kiosk.filters.${f}` returns matches — IF f is ever '' (empty string filter), it accesses the empty-key entry; benign value 'Tous' renders OK BUT key inspection in devtools shows 'kiosk.filters.' which is a code smell
adversarial_findings.remediation: rename the empty-string key to 'all' so it becomes 'kiosk.filters.all' — same value 'Tous' — and update any v-for iteration to filter empty-string keys defensively
